# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c30 P34](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0034)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Personality

Miss Stacy is an inspiring, conscientious, and caring educator who deeply values her pupils' well-being and academic progress. She offers wise and thoughtful advice, preferring her students to avoid overworking or cramming before major examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)_

- Conscientious  <sub>[v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
- Caring  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>
- Encouraging  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching and preparing students for examinations  <sub>[v1 c32 P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- Guide her students through their Entrance examinations  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Stacy taught at Avonlea school, taking over the position following Mr. Phillips's departure. She instructed her students, including the Queen's class, throughout the school term, helping them prepare for their upcoming Entrance examinations. Although offered a teaching role in her own home district's grade school, she decided to return to Avonlea due to her deep interest in her pupils. At the end of June, she accompanied students such as Anne Shirley, Jane, Ruby, and Josie to the Academy in town for their examinations, instructing them not to open a book or cram during exam week.

_Sources: [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)_

> Yes, I think I will. I thought of taking another school, but I have decided to come back to Avonlea. To tell the truth, I’ve grown so interested in my pupils here that I found I couldn’t leave them. So I’ll stay and see you through.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> But you’ve done good work this past year, and you deserve a good, jolly vacation. It will be the tug of war, you know—the last year before the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
